_comment: One agent's INSPECTION of every extracted image and every vector-figure render in this library, as data rather than code, so the judgement can be reviewed line by line and re-run (bean d5f1; vector renders, bean ay3x). `saw` is the REASON for the role, not the description; `draft` is the description. Every entry was produced by looking at the image or render file; where a thumbnail's text was too small to read, the draft says so rather than guessing. Applied by cat-harness-tools/scripts/apply-image-verdicts.ts, which writes an `inspection` basis naming this agent and leaves every narrative in `draft` -- only a human may confirm one (schemas/narrative.ts). No person has reviewed these drafts. The model is recorded as `not-disclosed` with the session it can be recovered from (schemas/attribution.ts, MODEL_NOT_DISCLOSED).

img-p011-1.saw: a line chart of monthly doses of Penta1, Penta3 and OPV3, 2012-2014
img-p011-1.draft: A line chart titled "Monthly reported number of doses administered, 2012-2014 for Penta1, Penta3, OPV3". The y-axis is reported number of doses administered (0 to 18000); the x-axis is year and month, January 2012 to December 2014. Penta 1 (blue) runs mostly between about 7000 and 10000 a month, with sharp peaks of about 16000 in December 2012 and about 12800 in August 2013; Penta 3 (red) follows a similar shape slightly lower, peaking at about 15000 in December 2012. OPV3 (green) tracks Penta 3 but peaks lower in December 2012 (about 10400) and has its own spike of about 9000 in January 2014, when the pentavalent doses are lower.
